title: 第 4章 那个天杀的！偷本座复阳的药？！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
看着手中被硬塞来的麻布袋子。

    这个时候了，李应灵又不是真傻子。

    哪里不知道这是别家宗门的药田。

    作为受到良好教育的门阀贵女，偷东西这种事，还是很挑战心里底线的！

    李应灵还打算开口询问。

    但是被楚星尘噤声的手势吓了一跳，又将嘴闭上了。

    楚星尘连忙小声道：“小声一点，别吵醒里面睡觉的好兄弟！快去，看见什么拿什么！”

    手中的袋子，里面的灵植，师父的督促！

    此时此刻，箭在弦上不得不发！

    李应灵一咬牙，就小心翼翼的从大洞里穿过！

    话本里不都说了吗，修仙世界尔虞我诈！

    自己成仙就代表有人不能成仙！

    修仙！肯定是这样的！

    走入灵田内，紧张的李应灵哪管什么东西，抄起最近的灵植就连根拔起。

    管它这个能有什么效果，也不管手法对不对，统统塞进麻袋里。

    到后面不知不觉也开始兴奋了起来，开始专门找发光最亮的拔！

    这玩意跟蜡烛一样，拔回去当灯用也行啊！

    李应灵最后将整个麻袋都塞的满满的，才意犹未尽的准备跑回去。

    这回倒是轮到楚星尘目瞪口呆，好家伙，这片灵田本就不大。

    毕竟只是一个小宗门罢了。

    大宗门目前的自己也不敢去找他们晦气。

    你这不客气倒是一点也不客气，几乎快拔光了四分之一。

    李应灵一脸兴奋的刚跑了出来。

    或许是太过兴奋，没有压住脚步，原本打着瞌睡的药田弟子被惊醒了过来。

    朦胧的睁开双眼，就发现药田之中少了一大片药材，尤其是几根掌门急需的药材被连根拔起，根都没留！

    哪家缺心眼的贼连复阳的药材都偷？！你跟掌门一样都不行吗？！

    看守弟子连忙大声咆哮，同时拉响警报的铃铛道：

    “有贼！快来人啊！有贼啊！”

    李应灵瞬间心跳拉满。

    楚星尘也反应迅速，拉起李应灵的手就立刻土遁连忙溜走。

    李应灵隐约间，听见……

    “那个天杀的！要偷本掌门好不容易集齐的仙草啊！芙蓉！本座对不起你啊！”
content_en:
He looked at the linen bag that was forced into his hand.

    At this time, Li Yingling was not really a fool.

    I didn't know that this was another sect's medicine field.

    As a well-educated noblewoman, stealing things is still a challenge to her bottom line!

    Li Yingling also planned to ask.

    But he was startled by Chu Xingchen's silent gesture and closed his mouth again.

    Chu Xingchen quickly whispered: "Keep your voice down, don't wake up the good brothers sleeping inside! Go quickly and grab whatever you see!"

    The bag in your hand, the spiritual plant inside, and the master’s supervision!

    At this moment, the arrow is on the string and has to be fired!

    Li Yingling gritted her teeth and carefully passed through the big hole!

    Isn’t it said in the storybook that the world of cultivating immortals is full of intrigues and intrigues?

    Becoming an immortal yourself means that someone else cannot become an immortal!

    Cultivation! That's for sure!

    Walking into the spiritual field, the nervous Li Yingling didn't care about anything, so she picked up the nearest spiritual plant and uprooted it.

    No matter what effect it can have, no matter whether the method is correct or not, stuff it all into the sack.

    Unknowingly, I started to get excited later on, and I started looking for the brightest one to pull out!

    This thing is like a candle, you can just pull it out and use it as a lamp!

    Li Yingling finally stuffed the entire sack before getting ready to run back.

    This time, it was Chu Xingchen's turn to be dumbfounded. Good guy, this spiritual field is not big at all.

    After all, it's just a small sect.

    Da Zongmen currently does not dare to seek bad luck from them.

    You are not polite at all, almost a quarter of it is gone.

    Li Yingling just ran out with excitement on her face.

    Perhaps because he was too excited and did not hold back, the Yaotian disciple who had been dozing off was woken up.

    Opening his eyes dimly, he found that a large amount of medicinal materials were missing from the medicine field, especially several medicinal materials that the master urgently needed had been uprooted, leaving no root behind!

    What kind of heartless thief would even steal Fuyang’s medicinal materials? ! Aren't you the same as the leader? !

    The guarding disciple quickly roared loudly and sounded the alarm bell at the same time:

    "There's a thief! Someone come quickly! There's a thief!"

    Li Yingling's heartbeat suddenly became full.

    Chu Xingchen also reacted quickly. He took Li Yingling's hand and immediately slipped away.

    Li Yingling vaguely heard...

    "Damn it! You want to steal the fairy grass that I finally collected with great difficulty! Furong! I'm sorry for you!"
title_en: Chapter 4 Damn it! Steal my Yang-rejuvenating medicine? !
